verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
KABAKA Mukama waffe
Atuyita ku mbaga ye;
Ategese ebya ssava,
Twanguwe okugendayo.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Kristo-okuyitako kwaffe
Omwana gw'endiga Yesu,
Eyaweebwayo ku lwaffe,
Tulyoke ffe tuwangule.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Kristo yava mu ntaana ye
N'obuwanguzi obungi
N'amaayi,okulokola
Ababi abamwesiga

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Aleruuya, Aleruuya;
Osaanidde ekitiibwa,
Naawe Katonda Kitaffe,
N'Omwoyo Omutukuvu
